text:
On April 26, 2023, at 6:10 PM, I received treatment for a dental bridge at F.F. Dental Clinic in Salaya. After examining me, the doctor administered two injections of local anesthetic. The doctor then moved to treat another patient in a different section (the same room). The doctor and this patient seemed to be very familiar with each other, engaging in conversation while I waited for a full hour. I couldn't wait any longer and went to the counter to pay for the anesthetic. I raised my voice because I had lost my patience; it had taken too long. The counter staff then informed the doctor. The patient who had skipped the queue then came out of the other room. The doctor asked to continue treating me. I then reprimanded the doctor for a lack of professionalism, stating that familiarity with someone was none of my concern, but that the doctor had left a patient waiting for an hour, listening to a completely pointless conversation.
**Importantly**, when it was time to begin treatment, the anesthetic had worn off. Furthermore, they told me that the anesthetic lasts for three hours, yet they needed to administer two more injections.
If F.F. Dental Clinic wishes to clarify or explain this, please contact me.
My name is Thitipong. Watthana Anankul
P.S. I am your patient. My mobile phone number is already available at your dental clinic.
Or if you wish to sue, please do so. I challenge you.
